描述_EN: il is composed, in the corner, of a network of lozenges adorned with dots and joined by the point, standing out against a red background. the frame features a very regular frieze of posts. fragment that certainly constituted the lower left part of a tapestry square. the remaining motifs are monochrome. Above the red zone, on the left-hand side, a recumbent animal, most likely a fawn, stares back. in the upper right side, another animal, perhaps a fawn, appears to leap wide open mouth.
描述_ZN: il在角落里由一个用点装饰的菱形网络组成，并由点连接，在红色背景下显得非常突出。 框架是由非常规则的柱子楣组成的。 美元的碎片肯定构成了一个挂毯广场的左下部分。 其余的图案是单色的。 在红色区域的上方，在左侧，有一只躺着的动物，可能是一只小鹿，回头看。 在右上方，另一只动物，也许是一只小鹿，似乎正张着大嘴跃出。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
